notes.title: Update 1.2 - Deeper Challenges
notes.content: [p]This update makes [i]PROTOCOL 11[/i] smoother and more challenging. Difficulty was increased with more enemies and reduced player health, and several bugs were fixed, including power-up activation, UI prompts, and odd character behavior. We also cleaned up unused upgrades and sprites, polished particles, and made various level improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Visuals have been enhanced with LBAO lighting, improved animations, and updated artwork. Audio has also been adjusted with fixes to breathing sounds. The demo is now re-enabled so new players can try the game before diving into the full experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's the changelog:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][i]Increased difficulty (more enemies, reduced player health)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Tweaked level design lighting, introducing LBAO (Light-Based Ambient Occlusion)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Improved animations and updated artwork[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Force jetpack to be given in levels after 4[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Improved particles for certain entities[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed issue where power-ups don’t activate with joystick[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed issue of some gamepad glyphs not appearing[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Added cooldown message when power-ups are activated[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Removed unused upgrades[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Changed text for the power-up (was “slow motion,” now “power-up module”)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed stuck “Press X to jump” message[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed icon getting stuck when reloading and switching to melee[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Replaced small area in level 4 (a box was causing the player to get stuck sometimes)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed Fita incorrect breathing sound[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed Phil facing direction issue on level 2’s ending[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Removed unused sprites[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed rendering issues on first person hand[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Re-enabled the demo[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Minor Level improvements[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Windows and MacOS builds are both updated.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing and for all the support, please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790"]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url="https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz"]Discord server[/url]![/p]

notes.title: 1.0 Version is finally here!
notes.content:
Version 1.0 is here! 

We're excited to announce that our game is now out of Early Access! With this update, we've made many big and small changes, including cool new effects, improved character animations, fixed display issues, and new multiplayer levels and surprises for you to enjoy. Dive in and experience the definitive version!

Here's the changelog:

⦁	Fixed UI elements incorrectly affected by post processing
⦁	Added LUT and better bloom effects
⦁	Added classic blood effects
⦁	Robot companion now have expressions
⦁	Larvs now have more variations and pickup effects
⦁	Improved medic AI and VFX
⦁	Improved VFX on enemy robot spiders.
⦁	Controls can now be tweaked in-game.
⦁	Improved animation while using ladders.
⦁	Added 3 new multiplayer levels.
⦁	Updated glyphs for Xbox, Playstation and SteamDeck controllers.
⦁	Improved Main Menu's navigation.
⦁	Multiple level improvements.
⦁	Fixed resolution aspect for Macbooks and Steam Decks.
⦁	Replaced visual indicator of last known position
⦁	Added easter egg on level4.
⦁	Tweaked some face expressions for certain cut-scenes.

We've poured our hearts into this project for many years and we're so happy to have reached this milestone with all of you!

Windows and MacOS builds are both updated.

Thank you for your patience, please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: SteamDeck Support
notes.content:
Hello Steam Deck users!

We’re excited to announce that PROTOCOL 11 now [b]fully supports the Steam Deck[/b] - and it works perfectly!

With this update, we’ve ensured that the game is [b]fully compatible[/b] with the device's controls. However, if you need to use a mouse for any reason, we’ve also enabled [b]touch screen support[/b]. Additionally, we’ve added [b]Steam Deck glyphs[/b] (those little button icons) along with new ones for PlayStation and Xbox controllers.

This update is currently available in the [b]debug branch[/b]. To access it, just go to [i]Properties -> Betas[/i] and select [i]"debug"[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/bfc01bae21b5c27a0ecce7024138c6214c6dd657.png[/img]

The update will be rolled out to all customers on the default branch in just a few days.

We hope you enjoy this update, and we’re glad that PROTOCOL 11 can now be played on the go!

Thank you for your patience, please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Local Multiplayer now available!
notes.content:
In our ever-lasting commitment to this project, we've added local multiplayer mode where you can challenge your friends! 

Choose your characters and battle it out—aim for 10 points to claim victory. And there's more in the future: upcoming arenas, a "last man standing" mode, awesome weapons, and plenty more to keep your gaming experience fresh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/ebf6f2093a02dca8806accda951bd31bb574b779.png[/img]

We've also fine-tuned controller support for Xbox 360, Xbox One, PS4, and PS5 controllers—now with vibration support included! Generic gamepads are also supported natively. If you use Steam Input, please disable it.

And by popular demand, you can now customize your keys! Your feedback matters, and we're dedicated to making the game exactly how you want it. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/2f79848c0da271511585d3008aa1b0f06ec31eb8.png[/img]

Other changes include:

[list]
[*] Final boss cannot be longer killed by vertical takedowns.
[*] Improved character animation, its speed is now determined by how much the left stick is held.
[*] Characters will no holster one handed guns while wall clinging.
[*] Character can no longer jump inside the cell.
[*] Fixed character not being able to jump on the first jumper, on first level.
[*] Fixed jitter effect not being disabled on death, for NPCs.
[*] Fixed interactable overlap issue on Timmy's section.
[*] Fixed missing checkpoint at the start of level5.
[*] Fixed player might get accidentally stuck on Waste Management area.
[*] Fixed game paused UI issues.
[*] Robot spiders won't have zombie hurt sounds.
[*] Fixed rare instances where character won't deploy weapon after a vertical takedown.
[*] Minor visual tweaks.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience, please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: SUPER Cute Alien legacy edition now available and exciting news!
notes.content:
Big news! 

SUPER Cute Alien DLC is now free for everyone who already has the game! It brings back the old campaign and multiplayer, so get ready for some serious nostalgia and fun. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710330/PROTOCOL_11__SUPER_Cute_Alien_Legacy_Edition/

And guess what? We're already working on Episode 2 and are bringing back the classic multiplayer mode! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/fce0aa8b4032925d2f5b348402b3401cc2a7b23e.jpg[/img]
[i](concept, not final artwork)[/i]

[h3]What can we expect from Episode 2?[/h3]
 
[list]
[*] [b]Continuation of the Story[/b]
Phil navigates Buenos Aires' ruins, aged by time, in pursuit of Fita. A few years have passed since the catastrophe, and survival intertwines with the quest for this mysterious beacon.

[*] [b]Metroidvania Genre[/b]
Unlocking new areas is vital to Phil's survival and understanding the city's secrets. Mastering tools and abilities reveals hidden passages essential for progress.

[*] [b]Broken Buenos Aires[/b]
Amidst debris-strewn streets, players discover remnants of Argentina's culture and history, adding depth to the desolate landscape.

[*] [b]Open World Dynamics[/b]
The city's open world teems with life and dynamic events. Day-night cycles, crate drops, multiple quests and bounty collectors create unpredictable challenges in the quest to uncover the city's history.
[/list]

We will be sharing more information in the future. Thanks for being awesome fans - get hyped for more adventures and epic battles as the game keeps getting better and better!

Remember you can leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: MacOS + Demo builds
notes.content:
We're excited to share the latest updates and improvements in the development of our game. Here's a summary of the key milestones and features included in Version 1.1.1:

[h3]MacOS Builds[/h3]
We're thrilled to announce that the game is now available for MacOS users. With the new MacOS builds, players can enjoy the game on their Apple computers and experience the thrilling gameplay firsthand.

[h3]Time-Limited Demo[/h3]
To give players a taste of the excitement our game has to offer, we have introduced a time-limited demo. This allows players to explore a portion of the game, for 30 minutes, showcasing our mechanics, immersive world, and gameplay.

[h3]Additional Skins[/h3]
In response to player feedback, we have expanded the selection of skins available in the game. Players can now personalize their characters with even more options, enhancing their gaming experience and allowing for greater self-expression.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
We understand the importance of delivering a smooth and seamless gaming experience. In this update, we have addressed several issues, including the problem of skins being deleted after replaying certain levels or completing an episode.

[h3]Level Design Tweaks[/h3]
Our commitment to improving the game's overall quality led us to make several level design tweaks. These adjustments aim to enhance the gameplay flow, provide more engaging challenges, and create a more immersive experience for players.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We strive to create an exceptional gaming experience, and we are excited to bring you more updates and improvements in future versions. 

Don't forget to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url]!

Stay tuned for more exciting announcements!

notes.title: Outfits, Expanded Story & Early Access Rewards
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we are currently working on expanding the character outfit options in our game, along with adding new story elements to enhance your gaming experience.

Player customization is an important aspect of any game, as it allows players to express their individuality and personal preferences. Being able to customize your character's appearance and outfits makes the game more immersive, and helps players feel more invested in the world they are playing in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/ec6aae08ca9392d4cd9b1fe485ec93619fe53b53.png[/img]

Most of these skins will be available for everyone, for free but a few ones will reserved as an exclusive rewards for early access backers. Thanks so much for your support!

Finally, the story is the heart of any game, as it provides the framework for the world and the events that take place within it. The more detailed and engaging the story is, the more invested players become in the game and its characters. Expanding the story elements helps to deepen the lore of the game, providing players with more opportunities to explore the world and uncover its secrets.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qXaDQhY.png[/img]

We are excited to share these new developments with you, and hope that they enhance your experience in our game. We believe this new free content should be ready in about two weeks. Stay tuned for more updates!


Thanks for reading. Please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Translations are now live!
notes.content:
Beta translations for multiple languages have been added and users are encouraged to provide feedback on any issues or improvements that can be made!

Besides English, we now support the following languages:

[list]
[*]     Spanish [es-US]	
[*]     French [fr-FR]	
[*]     Chinese (Simplified)
[*]     Japanese
[*]     Korean
[*]     German
[*]     Russian
[*]     Portuguese (Brazil)
[*]     Thai
[*]     Italian (Italy)
[/list]

Translations will have mistakes and we apologize in advance! If you are fluent in other languages, help us by tweaking some words or phrases, to have a higher quality translation for people in your country.

Select your language at start up, or at any time via Options Menu.

Here's a list of other fixes/improvements.
[list]
[*] Death feedback for robot spiders has been improved
[*] UI has been tweaked to improve readability
[*] AI reactions in certain scenarios have been slightly improved. 
[*] Levels have been adjusted to make some jumps easier and to improve cutscenes. 
[*] The ship battle feature has been improved to have better destruction. 
[*] A bug with the silencer not being applied on a weapon after a level change has been fixed. 
[*] The shiv uses have been increased and campfire music has been added. 
[*] An experimental dynamic grass feature has been added to level 5, which reacts to player movement and bullets and features different footstep sounds based on the player's velocity. We are considering adding this feature to the whole game if feedback is positive.
[/list]

Next updates will address campfire's experience, lore and player customization.

Thank you for your patience, please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Multi-language support has officially started!
notes.content:
Multi-language support enhances the experience for non-English speakers, or for those that feel more comfortable speaking in another language.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/050b5da655d6e04eaab4c598cf7d6f012b7209f9.gif[/img]

A week ago we officially started working on this by translating thousands of words. We believe we will have a beta for languages in about 3 weeks.

Besides English, we will be supporting the following languages:

[list]
[*] Spanish [es-US]	
[*] French [fr-FR]	
[*] Chinese (Simplified)	
[*] German	
[*] Russian	
[*] Japanese	
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)	
[*] Thai	
[*] Italian (Italy)
[/list]

This list will, of course, expand as user requests more languages.

We are a small indie company, [i]100% self-funded[/i], but if things continue to go well, we would like to hire voice actors for [b]full voice-over[/b] support for other languages, especially Spanish.

Translations will have mistakes and we apologize in advance! If you are fluent in other languages, help us by tweaking some words or phrases, to have a higher quality translation for people in your country.

If you would like us to support another language, please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: It's official: We give you... PROTOCOL 11!
notes.content:
It's been almost a year without updates. Is super hard to squeeze a year of content into a small devlog, but we will try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/6386c7a1875d598cb640534f74acb8951acfca30.png[/img]

First of all, [b]name change[/b]. As we grew as developers, we understood that world building is important. [i]SUPER Cute Alien[/i] always referenced the main character. While most of the game centers around a character (aka "[i]Fito[/i]" but changed to "[i]Phil[/i]"), we changed things a bit to have multiple protagonists. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/eb17067703552d122a0e1a7c4b716d2ed2fc25c6.png[/img]
[i](Phil, in the flesh)[/i]

The whole game is about 3 chapters, in different places of the universe, so we thought that a more fitting name would be better for the overall [b]sci-fi experience.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/d78b4ffbc1a94db92bdfd4dc7ed13bae9e3bd6c4.jpg[/img]

Game still retains its [b]cute/simple style[/b] with gore elements. That won't change. And yes: could be turned off.

[b]The Unity port is 100% complete,[/b] meaning we retain the same features from the old engine. So, we did that and also added new features.

So, for the rest of the changes... here we go:

[h3]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/397aea5a10fedcb32f2a4aacc1a83fa5f719db1b.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/ae2ee18efcfa17fc234bac0b1a19cf703d5e7bdd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/306d60994ca2a3b8df92072609623b6541f24d82.png[/img][/url]
[*] There’s now a resource system, to loot and craft components. This will help exploration and be helpful when we want the player to slow down a little.
[*] Players can now rescue prisoners. They can be useful to help you get across the world or to find out information on what’s happening.
[*] Stealth is now properly integrated in the world. You can do takedowns and hide in bushes.
[*] We now feature a campfire. In these, players can take a break to do some crafting, customize characters, save the game and more.
[*] Characters can now swim :)
[/list]

[h3]MOVEMENT CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Characters can now slide from angled surfaces, use ziplines and grab onto moving platforms.
[*] Variable jump height. The more you press your jump key, the higher the jump.
[*] Characters can now automatically jump over small obstacles. This prevents the player from doing micro jumps.
[/list]

[h3]COMBAT CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/e559fb237e1669560da26a0cd73525cac80377ae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/60ff5b2f3448a38cb69f2545b22083c94055bd17.png[/img][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/51b4d82f558a01bd2c3373ebfef5074902dcafe2.png[/img]
[*] Added 5 variations for common enemies. They can now deploy tools, do rappelling, call for backup, and throw grenades.
[*] More enemies were added, such as flying robots, crawling spiders, and attacking ships.
[*] Reworked damage systems.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/29864d166b57b60974ea1a1691e50514507c5956.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/d443f91e6e18a2d063331ff2c6b03901f132e448.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/14f39f5f13529ab01a7a545810ba0450bf64d9eb.png[/img][/url]
[*] Added dynamic gore system and blood decals.
[*] Reworked all weapons and added new ones.
[/list]

[h3]GFX CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/84797dd5c51e638d58258b86a8fa127b38733f38.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/t0P6tla.jpeg[/img]
[*] Inspired by Rayman Origins, Half-Life 2 and studio Ghibli, we tweaked our general world art to have simple forms, retaining its readability.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/35350a3ef2ea2765a4b8ccdb4845164c5058b29f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/4feb032ab12615462f1b268db04b1dd85ce04334.png[/img][/url]
[*] We upgraded all our characters to use a new skeleton. This also brings better animations, for more readability.
[*] The main camera is now a 3D camera which uses perspective. This makes our layers, essentially, 3D. This brings much more depth into our worlds.
[*] We use an improved lighting system, for lights and shadows. Also let us feature emissive textures, which is great.
[/list]

[h3]HUD CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/dfa08922ee849177500bf1d62e14ba487cd5602a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/611f44c7f22ac368a411ebbd920deca50d050dbd.png[/img][/url]
[*] We improved the health display and introduced an armor system.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/f28f43c6c89a5a32127116a1b932330834b24c54.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/4754b5c4f0a99b31389f3eef343638fded67b10c.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/3f1b1cdafd25d2e8b1a63fa7f2a0296f15a05552.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/d0f19a55ec841cefbc303ab02770d561887e5f33.png[/img][/url]
[*] The weapon wheel got a big rework. Slots can be enabled/disabled, arrows can be crafted and there’s an ammo counter for each weapon. When you pick a weapon, it goes to its corresponding slot. Works flawlessly for gamepads too.
[/list]
[h3]
THE LITTLE THINGS...[/h3]
[list]
[*] Less is more. We reworked bits of the story and its dialogs to help make the message come across, in a much better way.
[*] We want to have a tactical approach, when it comes to combat. Due to the nature of 2D, it is a bit hard to have a general big view of an area, to plan your attack. This is why you can now send your ally robot to scout ahead! This effectively solves a problem of how to approach a combat situation, where to go, if using stealth or not, which enemies prioritize, etc.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/456856b4bb85fb926131ad5d9d20526e3fd49f10.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/0225fdeae43ebea7182a2f692645526bcb0ee328.png[/img][/url]
[*] To aid exploration, players can now pick collectibles on areas that go off route a bit.
[*] We want to marry gameplay and story as much as we can. This is why you can now rename your robot ally in the campfire, and since Phil is an artist, now you can draw sketches too.
[/list]


[h2]WHAT's NEXT?[/h2]
[b]The demo for Steam Next! [/b]This hopefully gets done by October 2022. Would contain most of the content we’ve been working on, except for coop and versus multiplayer.

Remember you can [url=https://twitter.com/SUPERCuteAlien]follow us on Twitter[/url], for faster updates.

Oh, and here's the change log, in a super fast scrolling gif format!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/8d73a83c4b0ae1e53e9ddfecae8eb9a17c8787b8.gif[/img]

Hope you like the progress so far! [b]See you in October![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36921758/274b48e74a6110f0d772791cab48c7ae25301776.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Adopting Unity Technologies
notes.content:
Hey there! Since we re received a[b] big influx of people[/b] over the past weeks, we decided to do a quick [b]update [/b]about something we've been doing [u]under the shadows[/u]. So, let's get it out of the way:
[h3]🎉 We decided to adopt Unity Technologies! 🎉[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eHbsdHi.jpg[/img]


This is an incredible important change for our project, in regards of[b] features, performance, visual effects and workflow[/b]!

We are currently doing a[b] direct port[/b]. That means, [b]in this step[/b] we are only focusing on making [b]a 1:1 representation of what we had[/b] under our previous engine.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oTeAfiw.png[/img]


After that step is done, we plan of using 100% of what Unity allows us to do. Here's a tiny list of what we have planned:
[list][*][b]Better terrain.[/b] This means that tiles will be gone. Being able to do terrains in any shape will make levels much more interesting and nicer to look at![/*][/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JDMlmB4.png[/img]

[list][*][b]Post processing.[/b] We wanted to achieve a special, distinctive look from quite a while. One step in cartoon like visuals, another step in reality. Now our visuals will be able to achieve quality in the likes from Rayman Origins, Ori and the Blind Forest![/*][*][b]Small video tutorials.[/b] I love these games where they use a small video box that shows you what to do, in a quick, effective way. This will be in.[/*][*][b]Better water/blood.[/b] Since the fundation of the project, we played around liquids. They used 'metaballs' and some rendering tech that let us spawn realistic blood squirts. These rendering techniques weren't available for us but now we are able to make them again![/*][*][b]Better lighting.[/b] We had a very simple light system, but we want to extend this to serve a gameplay purpose:[/*][/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a2BAb8V.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GXiBst8.png[/img]

[list][*][b]Ultra-wide[/b] support + [b]HDR[/b]![/*][*][b]More than 4 gamepads [/b]for an amazing local play![/*][*][b]Multiplayer online[/b]![/*][*]Something about [b]exploration[/b]? Due to our linear nature of our levels, we can't get much exploration in. But we are planning to improve that, so you can do [b]quests around the map[/b], or just [b]exploring and finding [/b]a very special item![/*][/list]
As for gameplay features, everything will stay intact. However, we are planning to use multiple weapons at once, on story mode, and implement an AI feature that reacts to that. More info on this later.

Speaking of AI, we already worked on most of it:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8MmC3b7.gif[/img]


[Smarty AI in action]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cz0CI4t.gif[/img]


[Generic AI in action]

One of the things we are most proud about, is the[u] "what you see is what you get"[/u] workflow. That makes things incredibly fast. Plus, [b]we run scripts inside the editor itself[/b], so we don't need to compile each time we do a little change. [b]The editor itself is our game! [/b]We also took advantage of these called [u]Gizmos[/u], so we can quickly see what triggers what, in a quick glance:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XmH0QdM.png[/img]

Good thing is that [b]most of the features are already implemented on this Unity port[/b], but still there's a bunch to do, specially on the multiplayer side of things, but since we improved our workflow a lot (we are implementing 2 or 3 features each day!) we believe this will be done [u]super [/u]fast.

Speaking of progress and what to do, here's a nice picture to let you see[b] where we at:[/b]
[h3]ROADMAP[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pd54dYI.jpg[/img]


Well, that's it for now. [b]Hope you are as excited as we are[/b], and thanks for your continued support over the years!

Any issue, please let us know. Have fun!
